pca_note: Feature vector = 48-bin log radial Fourier power + 24-bin gradient orientation histogram on 128x128 physical-height proxy. The JSON includes scaler/components so generated masks can be projected in-browser.

pc_axis_interpretation.pc1: This axis is dominated by radial spectral-power bins and separates fine/high-frequency mesh-like content from smoother low-frequency masks. Sign is arbitrary; in this fit negative PC1 has stronger mid/high-frequency radial power.
pc_axis_interpretation.pc2: This axis is dominated by low radial spectral-power bins and separates broad low-frequency/large-cell structure from fine repetitive texture. Sign is arbitrary; in this fit positive PC2 has stronger low-frequency radial power.
